location_description: Seaford is a city located along the Nanticoke River in Sussex County, Delaware, United States.  According to the 2010 Census Bureau figures, the population of the city is 6,928, an increase of 3.4% from the 2000 census. It is part of the Salisbury, Maryland-Delaware Metropolitan Statistical Area.
